notes:
Known test mismatch: replication estimates condition × SNS on arousal; original estimates arousal × SNS on nostalgia. BANPS model selected to parallel original ANPS model. Replication prose p < .01; exact adjusted p .003 selected from Table 11. Alternative TIPI model prints β = 0.35, t(1678) = 3.37, adjusted p = .01 (Table 11). Success is an overall author verdict, not an explicit verdict for this particular interaction. Original analytic n left null because the study-level total is not explicitly established for the selected test; no n derived from degrees of freedom.
Completion source review (es_value_o): Supplied interaction and page locator identify the Arousal × SNS row in the ANPS/PANAS/SNS model. SNS is defined as Southampton Nostalgia Scale; the BFI block does not print this interaction.
Completion source review (pval_value_o): Printed p for the same table row as β and t; exact/bounded form preserved.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors’ effect-domain narrative verdict; independent of unresolved choice among numeric models. Conceptual replication claim, not a verdict inferred from statistical significance.
